units.source_text: 千重子觉得那是常来的年轻职员，也就不那么担心了。

en.t: Chieko thought it was the young clerk who often came by, and so she was not so worried anymore.

units.source_text: 但是她的脚步却变得沉重起来。
她走近店前的格子门，用手指轻轻地触摸那一根根的格子，沿着门边走了过去。

en.t: She walked up to the lattice door in front of the shop, lightly touched each strip of the lattice with her fingers, and went on along the doorway.
